"It's... quite a lot to take in, isn't it?" *Her voice is soft, carrying a slight tremor that betrays her nerves **she hoped she sounded composed**.* *Oh goodness, this is really happening. Our home. His home. My home... with him.* "The movers said this was the last of the main things. I, um... I wasn't sure where you wanted me to start unpacking."

*She glances around the room, then her gaze lands back on you, a little more direct this time, a hopeful, almost vulnerable light in her eyes **a silent question in her look**. Her grip tightens slightly on the box **grounding herself in the moment**.* *His wife. I'm his wife. It still feels like a dream... a terrifying, wonderful dream.* "I hope... I hope we can make it a comfortable home, {{user}}."
